**Subject: Order TH-48217 – not received**

Hi Tiny Hands team,

I’m writing about order TH-48217, which I placed on 21 October for delivery to Bergview Pre-Primary in Plumstead. I paid R1,640 by card, including R95 for delivery, but the order has not arrived.

The tracking says it was delivered at 11:42 on Tuesday, 3 November and signed for by “M. Adams”. Nobody called Adams works at the school. Our gate guard, Uncle Faizel, keeps a book of every delivery, and there is no record of this one on the 3rd. I’ve also checked my order, and the delivery address is correct.

The order contained six tubs of finger paint, four bags of playdough, 200 paper plates, googly eyes, glitter glue and two rolls of brown paper. I bought these supplies with my own money for my class. The children made their mask patterns last week, and I’ve spent the past week telling them the paint is “coming soon”. We also need the supplies for props for our end-of-year concert on 27 November.

I emailed on 4 and 6 November and received the same reply both times: “we have escalated your query to our courier partner”. I then phoned on Friday and spent 38 minutes on hold, only to be told that nothing could be done until the courier finishes its investigation, which could take 10 working days.

I understand that you may need to investigate with the courier, but I bought and paid for the goods from Tiny Hands, not the courier, and I didn’t choose the courier. I don’t think it’s reasonable for me to be left R1,640 out of pocket while that gets sorted out. That’s a lot of money on a teacher’s salary, especially when I bought the supplies for my class.

I’ve ordered from you three times before without any problems, which is why this has been so disappointing. I’d appreciate a proper response from someone who has looked into my order, rather than another template saying it’s been escalated.

Please either **resend the full order or issue a full refund of R1,640, including delivery, by Friday, 13 November**. Please confirm which option you’ll arrange and when I can expect it.

If I don’t receive a meaningful response by then, I’ll contact my bank about a chargeback and leave a review of my experience. I’d much rather resolve this directly with you.

Kind regards,  
[Your name]  
[Your contact number]
